title: Active Opposition
description:
Active Opposition is a story-based game where we play the actions of Adam and his brother to rise in the criminal world.

STORY

An intelligence agent has been kidnapped. Since the operation is not official, the state cannot intervene in the situation. The most suitable name for this job is Adam, a newcomer to the city.
Adam strives to rise in the criminal underworld, he will find himself in the midst of schemes he never understood and he will need his brother’s help to face the hurdles

İSTANBUL

You'll witness historical landmarks on a map inspired by Istanbul, and you'll shake the stones from their places in this elder city.

ADAM
Ruthlessly eliminating his enemies,Adam does not consider the consequences of his actions

Take cover and survive the fight. If you don't spend your bullets carefully, you may get into trouble.

METO
Even though he wants to solve problems with his intelligence,events will quickly get out of his control

Climb and peek to get one step ahead of events
